reviews.author: Bree Oliphant
reviews.text: I had been dealing with issues on my truck for a while, rough idle, shaking, warning lights, and electrical problems, and this shop finally got everything handled the right way. They took the time to properly diagnose the issues instead of just guessing and replacing parts. The staff was professional, honest, and kept me updated throughout the repair process. My truck is now running much smoother, idling better, and driving like it should again. You can tell they actually care about their work and their customers. Pricing was fair, turnaround time was good, and they treated me with respect from start to finish. I definitely recommend this shop to anyone needing reliable repairs or diagnostics done right. I’ll be bringing my vehicles back here in the future.

reviews.author: Joseph
reviews.text: Excellent teamwork, thorough assessment of your vehicles needs, clear explanation of findings and solutions with prompt completion of your service just as they promise. Ralph is friendly, engaging and very good at making you feel comfortable with the care at Performance Plus. He monitors the process with the service team and keeps you updated through your time there. They truly do above and beyond for their customer. I trust my auto repair needs completely to Performance Plus.

reviews.author: Grover Christian
reviews.text: Service completed in just a few hours. Prices were very reasonable. Manager listened to my concerns and diagnosed the issues quickly and accurately. Alignment issues were corrected…drives like new.

reviews.author: OG J. D.
reviews.text: Had some issues with my 94 Dodge Dakota Sport, they got me in diagnosed the problems and got them fixed…. Nothing was worked on without customer approval first which is what I absolutely liked from the beginning, Rafael was very nice! Excellent customer service! And I’m thankful to the technicians for doing the work the right way! Thank you God is good all the time, I made the right choice with Performance Plus!

reviews.author: Renee Barlow
reviews.text: I have brought several cars here because I really trust the quality of their work. Excellent communication, fast service. We have dealt with Rafael several times and highly recommend.

reviews.author: Deneria Logan
reviews.text: Rusty is definitely a great guy, he’s very fair on pricing, you can tell he’s very compassionate about his job. He has a great team of guys behind him! Check them out at Performance Automotive!

reviews.author: Frank
reviews.text: They replaced my rear end on my 2019 Camaro SS. My car now drivers better than it ever has. Ralph kept me updated on my car and gave me an accurate estimate on when it would be completed.

reviews.author: Laura Amick
reviews.text: Same day service, dropped it at 8:30 and picked it up at 4. New rotors & brakes, front and back, oil change and fluids filled. My Yukon drives like a new one, no problem at all. Excellent service, i recommend Performance Plus Auto Service. & Would give it 10 stars if I could..

reviews.author: Keyona Butler
reviews.text: Very trustworthy. 100% accurate! job is very great customer service is excellent and environment is clean and comfortable. I can count on PPA. best place to get an oil change in the city . love my crew they always get me right.

reviews.author: Jacob Sagona
reviews.text: Hey Greenwood this is the shop to go to! I recently took my car in to have the alternator replaced and not only was the cost super reasonable but the customer service was excellent! If I ever need service again Im definitely coming back here!

reviews.author: Christine Hagen
reviews.text: I needed a broken bolt extracted from the frame of my Caravan. Performance Plus did what needed to be done that no other shop could do. Cutting and welding and now I’m able to get a Hitch installed. Thanks to the friendly and caring Guys.

reviews.author: Angela Westall
reviews.text: Very impressed with the service we got here. Rusty, Ralph and Kerry go out of their way to assure they get things right for their customers. They are really good people to work with and we will be back! Thank you

reviews.author: John Sagona
reviews.text: Great service, kind and respectful. Got my car turned around in a day, $600 cheaper than other quotes. Ralph is the best!

reviews.author: Kwan Allen
reviews.text: Very respectful very reasonable. Tell you everything about your car good and bad. Also give you a estimate before they start. Great turn around time. My number one shop in my book!!!!!

reviews.author: Chitikia Holmes
reviews.text: They provide great service and good customer service every time. Never had any issues since I’ve been bringing my car here! They are my number one mechanics!

reviews.author: Stikc James
reviews.text: I went to several shop to fix the issue with my vehicle, I made the appointment and they had the issue fix and vehicle out in a couple of hours. Thank for the great work and customer service.

reviews.author: Clyde Lee
reviews.text: Just took my diesel truck in for an oil change and new fuel filters . Top notch crew and service ! By far the quickest and least expensive oil/fuel filter change I've gotten. Highly recommend ..

reviews.author: aviar lover
reviews.text: I would highly recommend Performance Plus to anyone. As a first time customer myself, I relied on their team to install a new engine in my truck. I was very pleased with overall experience. They communicated with me during process, worked with me on pricing, and completed the job on time. They earned my business in the future!

reviews.author: Kobe4X
reviews.text: I appreciate Mr. Ralph and his crew of guys for the great service and for getting in and out. Definitely will be back.

reviews.author: Clyde Lee
reviews.text: Best places hands down !! Anything you need done they got it !! From my personal truck to my work vehicles !! Thank yall for everything !!

reviews.author: gene cantrell
reviews.text: Took my truck up there to get aliment and see why wheel was vibrating.They said wheel wasn't tightened.Said it was good just needs another tire.Two days later my truck sitting in my friend's yard with broke studs now.Chareged me $152 something.Now I can't get to my job this morning and got to find a ride to get parts and do it myself.

reviews.author: Curtis Hampton
reviews.text: I recently contacted Performance Plus Auto to find a transmission for a friend's beloved car. Throughout numerous phone calls and exchanges of information, I was thoroughly impressed with Ralph. Every time, he provided exceptional customer service while helping me with my request to install a transmission for a 2003 Cadillac Seville. Unfortunately, Ralph couldn't fulfill my search, but it wasn't due to a lack of trying. In our final conversation, Ralph, being a straightforward and honest repairman, advised me that replacing the transmission probably wouldn’t be a worthwhile investment. I appreciated his honesty and thanked him.

reviews.author: Rico1LE
reviews.text: Great people to deal with. Got my ram 1500 fixed up and also checked my truck over for their issues.

reviews.author: Lisa Rauton
reviews.text: These gentlemen were good at repairing my car and I would be using them again with all my maintenance problems on my vehicles.

reviews.author: Ashleigh Johnson
reviews.text: I came in and my back tire was literally about to fall off they got me right in that morning and had me good to go in no time! Very professional quality trusted work! Everyone is so nice at that shop will definitely be coming back!!! Thank you guys!!

reviews.author: Matthew Trotter
reviews.text: Great!!!! Had a 2007 F150 lariat was skipping and the motor was just all out of wack I need a motor replaced and they got the job done haven’t had any issues what so ever! Great shop, great people!

reviews.author: Michael Griffin
reviews.text: This place goes above and beyond for their customers hands down! If you need dealership quality work and not dealership prices Performance Plus is your go to place for all your automotive repair needs!

reviews.author: Clarence Knaack
reviews.text: Had alignment done there. I complained that alignment was not correct and there answer was roads. Not that they didn’t take there time or they made a mistake or to double check it. Well 50 bucks down the drain. I took to firestone and had it done for 79 and it’s perfect, they showed me it was out. Never will I go back for anything.

reviews.author: Old Cav. Scout

Don't trust them. They tell you one price and then Jack it up several hundred dollars. Took ride to a different shop

reviews.author: Dewayne Edmonds
reviews.text: I took my daughter's car there. They diagnosed the problem quickly, the staff was very friendly, I would definitely come back thank you guys

reviews.author: Edith Adams
reviews.text: I am very pleased with the service I received. I’ve had both oil change and brakes repaired. They are very friendly and professional, I highly recommend 10 out of 10…..

reviews.author: Dennis Parris
reviews.text: Good folks. They diagnosed and fixed my car in a timely manner, And was 100% clear on what was done to my car. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Shaleda Palmore
reviews.text: Ralph and the staff are the best. Whenever there is something wrong with my car we always know who to take it to. We even send my mom over to him and he has fixed some things on her car as well. We definitely know who to call.

reviews.author: Nora Taylor
reviews.text: I had a great experience at this auto shop. Customer service was great, and the guy at the front desk was very helpful and friendly. Thanks again!
